title: Deliver the workflow's own design to every project
situation: An architect starting cold in a new project has only the workflow's moves (role procedure lines, tool explanations), not the practice as a whole, which only cratylus's own journal holds; the record names a workflow-delivery cut but never defines it.
decision: Proposed: the workflow context's current design (its subject, relation and live concepts) is projected from cratylus's own journal at release, placed read-only under the owned root with the agents, and shown by the concept journal's views in every project beside the user's own contexts, marked as delivered and versioned; it is never written into a user's journal. History and decisions are not delivered. Checked deterministically: in an empty project the overview shows the delivered workflow context, equal to its source.
consequences: Accepted, it becomes a cut of the delivery context, followed by the consumer trial as its test in use.
